new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8993b8ae74b98e3a55c56fd5f236915c2ca9bf50
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/fixmerge/directed_helper.py
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+"""Arrange real cached credits before letting the helper's final peer send."""
+import threading
+import time
+import importlib.util
+import os
+import _lib
+import atomicwindow
+
+if os.environ.get("FIXMERGE_PRE_HELPER"):
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pre_window", os.environ["FIXMERGE_PRE_HELPER"])
+    atomicwindow = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(atomicwindow)
+
+
+def held_burst(host, port, **kwargs):
+    real_conn = _lib.Conn
+    observer = real_conn(host, port)
+    opened = [observer]
+    release_peer = threading.Event()
+    completed = [threading.Event() for _ in range(9)]
+
+    def counts():
+        return {row.tid: row.clients for row in _lib.lbsignals(observer).threads if row.role == "io"}
+
+    def until(predicate, label, seconds=3):
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
+        while not predicate():
+            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                raise AssertionError(label)
+            time.sleep(0.002)
+
+    def on_io(owner):
+        for _ in range(128):
+            before = counts()
+            client = real_conn(host, port)
+            opened.append(client)
+            assert client.must("PING") == b"PONG"
+            until(lambda: sum(counts().values()) == sum(before.values()) + 1,
+                  "accept count did not publish")
+            after = counts()
+            changed = [tid for tid in after if after[tid] != before[tid]]
+            assert len(changed) == 1 and after[changed[0]] == before[changed[0]] + 1
+            if changed[0] == owner:
+                return client
+            client.close()
+            until(lambda: counts() == before, "discarded connection did not drain")
+        raise AssertionError("could not arrange requested IO placement")
+
+    try:
+        owners = sorted(counts())
+        assert len(owners) == 6
+        holder_io, peer_io, admin_io = owners[:3]
+        admin = on_io(admin_io)
+        burst = [on_io(holder_io) for _ in range(9)] + [on_io(peer_io)]
+        blocker = on_io(holder_io)
+        primers = [on_io(holder_io) for _ in range(4)]
+        buckets = _lib.owner_buckets(observer, "fixmerge-prime", per_owner=255, limit=16384)
+        keys = [values for values in buckets.values() if len(values) >= 255][:2]
+        payloads = []
+        sizes = [64, 64, 64, 63]
+        start = 0
+        for count in sizes:
+            payloads.append(b"".join(_lib.encode("MSET", keys[0][i], "p", keys[1][i], "q")
+                                     for i in range(start, start + count)))
+            start += count
+        print(f"DIRECTED holder_io={holder_io}, peer_io={peer_io}, admin_io={admin_io}", flush=True)
+
+        def stats():
+            table = _lib.info(observer, "stats")
+            return int(table["atomic_inflight"]), int(table["atomic_credit_pool"])
+
+        primed = False
+
+        class Wrapped:
+            def __init__(self, inner, index=None):
+                self.inner, self.index, self.reads = inner, index, 0
+
+            def __getattr__(self, name):
+                return getattr(self.inner, name)
+
+            def raw(self, payload):
+                if self.index == 9:
+                    assert release_peer.wait(10), "peer was never released"
+                return self.inner.raw(payload)
+
+            def read(self):
+                reply = self.inner.read()
+                if self.index is not None and self.index < 9:
+                    self.reads += 1
+                    if self.reads == 64:
+                        completed[self.index].set()
+                return reply
+
+            def must(self, *args):
+                nonlocal primed
+                reply = self.inner.must(*args)
+                if self.inner is admin and args == ("CONFIG", "SET", "atomic", "1") and not primed:
+                    primed = True
+                    until(lambda: all(event.is_set() for event in completed), "holder bursts did not finish")
+                    until(lambda: stats()[0] == 1, "only old lease must survive before priming")
+                    assert admin.must("CONFIG", "SET", "atomic", "1") == b"OK"
+                    assert stats() == (1, 255)
+                    assert observer.must("DEBUG", "ATOMIC-COMMIT-HOLD", "1") == b"OK"
+                    for client, payload in zip(primers, payloads):
+                        client.raw(payload)
+                    until(lambda: stats()[0] == 256, "255 current-generation groups were not admitted")
+                    assert observer.must("DEBUG", "ATOMIC-COMMIT-HOLD", "0") == b"OK"
+                    for client, count in zip(primers, sizes):
+                        for _ in range(count):
+                            assert client.read() == b"OK"
+                    until(lambda: stats() == (1, 0), "cached-credit state was not arranged")
+                    print("DIRECTED inflight=1 pool=0; releasing final 64-group peer burst", flush=True)
+                    release_peer.set()
+                return reply
+
+        prepared = [Wrapped(admin)] + [Wrapped(client, i) for i, client in enumerate(burst)] + [Wrapped(blocker)]
+
+        def assigned_conn(*args, **kw):
+            assert prepared, "unexpected additional connection in directed witness"
+            return prepared.pop(0)
+
+        _lib.Conn = assigned_conn
+        result = atomicwindow.held_burst(host, port, **kwargs)
+        assert primed and not prepared
+        assert int(result.split("lease_reclaims=", 1)[1].split()[0]) > 0, result
+        return result
+    finally:
+        _lib.Conn = real_conn
+        release_peer.set()
+        try:
+            observer.must("DEBUG", "ATOMIC-COMMIT-HOLD", "0")
+        finally:
+            for client in opened:
+                client.close()
diff --git a/build/fixmerge/focused.py b/build/fixmerge/focused.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..08ca847fa155ab456ad7520548717664df424d4c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/fixmerge/focused.py
@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+"""Fresh-boot failure controls and live coverage of the lease-reclamation branch."""
+from contextlib import closing
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+OUT = ROOT / "build/fixmerge/focused"
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
+import _lib
+
+rows = json.loads((OUT / "results.json").read_text()) if (OUT / "results.json").exists() else []
+
+
+def save():
+    (OUT / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+
+def stop(child):
+    if child.poll() is None:
+        child.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
+        try:
+            child.wait(timeout=30)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            child.kill()
+            child.wait(timeout=10)
+            raise AssertionError(f"PID {child.pid} required SIGKILL")
+    return child.returncode
+
+
+def run(name, port, fault=None, no_hold=False, directed=False, pre=False):
+    directory = OUT / name
+    (directory / "data").mkdir(parents=True)
+    binary = ROOT / ("build/fixmerge/negative-server/build/tomokv" if fault else "build/tomokv")
+    helper = ROOT / ("build/fixmerge/no-hold-atomicwindow.py" if no_hold else "tests/atomicwindow.py")
+    if directed:
+        helper = ROOT / "build/fixmerge/directed_helper.py"
+    env = dict(os.environ, TOMO_GATE_STRICT="1", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
+    if fault:
+        env[fault] = "1"
+    if pre:
+        env["FIXMERGE_PRE_HELPER"] = str(ROOT / "build/fixmerge/pre-atomicwindow.py")
+    command = ["taskset", "-c", "8-15", str(binary), "--port", str(port),
+               "--bind", "127.0.0.1", "--shards", "16", "--ratio", "6:2",
+               "--atomic", "1", "--enable-debug-command", "yes", "--dir", str(directory / "data")]
+    if directed:
+        command += ["--key-lb", "0", "--client-lb", "0", "--flip-auto", "0"]
+    row = {"name": name, "command": command, "fault": fault,
+           "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+           "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
+    if pre:
+        row["pre_helper_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(Path(env["FIXMERGE_PRE_HELPER"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+    rows.append(row)
+    with socket.socket() as probe:
+        probe.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
+        probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
+    with (directory / "server.log").open("w") as output:
+        server = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        row["server_pid"] = server.pid
+        save()
+        try:
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+            while True:
+                assert server.poll() is None, "server exited before readiness"
+                try:
+                    with closing(_lib.Conn("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=1)) as client:
+                        assert client.must("PING") == b"PONG"
+                    break
+                except (OSError, EOFError):
+                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                        raise
+                    time.sleep(0.1)
+            with closing(_lib.Conn("127.0.0.1", port)) as client:
+                roles = list(_lib.topology(client).roles.values())
+                assert roles.count("io") == 6 and roles.count("ex") == 2, roles
+            code = ("import importlib.util,sys; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); "
+                    "spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('probe_window',sys.argv[2]); "
+                    "m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); "
+                    "print('RESULT '+m.held_burst('127.0.0.1',int(sys.argv[3]),"
+                    "whole_window=True,reconfigure=True),flush=True)")
+            args = ["taskset", "-c", "16-23", sys.executable, "-c", code,
+                    str(ROOT / "tests"), str(helper), str(port)]
+            row["helper_command"] = args
+            with (directory / "helper.log").open("w") as log:
+                child = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+                row["helper_pid"] = child.pid
+                save()
+                try:
+                    row["helper_exit"] = child.wait(timeout=90)
+                finally:
+                    stop(child)
+            row["helper_log"] = (directory / "helper.log").read_text()
+        finally:
+            row["server_exit"] = stop(server)
+            output.flush()
+            reports = [json.loads(line.removeprefix("shutdown_report "))
+                       for line in (directory / "server.log").read_text().splitlines()
+                       if line.startswith("shutdown_report ")]
+            row["shutdown"] = reports[-1] if reports else None
+            save()
+    assert row["server_exit"] == 0 and row["shutdown"], row
+    assert all(value == 0 for value in row["shutdown"]["stuck"].values()), row
+    expected_failure = bool(fault or no_hold or pre)
+    assert (row["helper_exit"] != 0) == expected_failure, row
+    if expected_failure:
+        expected = {"FIXMERGE_BREAK_BOUND": ("exceed derived limit", "old lease accounting"),
+                    "FIXMERGE_BREAK_CARRY": ("credits did not return", "atomic burst did not resume", "old lease accounting")}
+        fragments = (("old lease accounting did not settle",) if pre else
+                     ("lease holder", "lease hold") if no_hold else expected[fault])
+        assert any(fragment in row["helper_log"] for fragment in fragments), row
+    print(name, "expected FAIL" if expected_failure else "PASS",
+          row["helper_log"].splitlines()[-1], flush=True)
+    return row
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "directed-pre":
+        run("directed-pre", 8409, directed=True, pre=True)
+    elif len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "directed":
+        run("directed", 8405, directed=True)
+    else:
+        run("no-hold", 8406, no_hold=True)
+        run("wrong-bound", 8407, fault="FIXMERGE_BREAK_BOUND")
+        run("lost-carry", 8408, fault="FIXMERGE_BREAK_CARRY")
+        for number in range(1, 21):
+            row = run(f"live-{number:02d}", 8411 + ((number - 1) % 9))
+            result = [line for line in row["helper_log"].splitlines() if line.startswith("RESULT ")][-1]
+            count = int(result.split("lease_reclaims=", 1)[1].split()[0])
+            if count > 0:
+                print("PASS live reclamation branch fired:", count, flush=True)
+                break
+        else:
+            raise AssertionError("live reclamation branch did not fire in 20 fresh boots")
diff --git a/build/fixmerge/verify.py b/build/fixmerge/verify.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..e439998e068015b088d861a9e035037f51b31839
--- /dev/null
+++ b/build/fixmerge/verify.py
@@ -0,0 +1,155 @@
+"""Local evidence runner; starts and stops only its own children."""
+import hashlib
+from contextlib import closing
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+OUT = ROOT / "build/fixmerge"
+if len(sys.argv) > 1:
+    OUT /= sys.argv[1]
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests"))
+import _lib
+
+ENV = dict(os.environ, TOMO_GATE_STRICT="1", PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
+record = {
+    "head": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
+    "binary_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "build/tomokv").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "tests/atomicwindow.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+    "server_cores": "8-15", "client_cores": "16-23", "runs": [],
+}
+
+
+def save():
+    (OUT / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
+
+
+def stop(child):
+    if child.poll() is None:
+        child.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
+        try:
+            child.wait(timeout=30)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            child.kill()
+            child.wait(timeout=10)
+            raise AssertionError(f"our child PID {child.pid} required SIGKILL")
+    return child.returncode
+
+
+def run_boot(number, fused=False):
+    mode = "1s" if fused else "2s"
+    port = 8410 if fused else 8399 + number
+    directory = OUT / ("fused-smoke" if fused else f"split-{number:02d}")
+    directory.mkdir()
+    data = directory / "data"
+    data.mkdir()
+    with socket.socket() as probe:
+        probe.bind(("127.0.0.1", port))
+    command = ["taskset", "-c", "8-15", str(ROOT / "build/tomokv"),
+               "--port", str(port), "--bind", "127.0.0.1", "--shards", "16",
+               "--dir", str(data), "--atomic", "1", "--enable-debug-command", "yes"]
+    command += ["--thread-mode", "fused", "--read-local", "1"] if fused else ["--ratio", "6:2"]
+    run = {"mode": mode, "port": port, "command": command, "batteries": []}
+    record["runs"].append(run)
+    save()
+    with (directory / "server.log").open("w") as log:
+        server = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+        run["pid"] = server.pid
+        print(f"START {directory.name}: PID {server.pid}, port {port}", flush=True)
+        try:
+            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
+            while True:
+                if server.poll() is not None:
+                    raise AssertionError("server exited before accepting")
+                try:
+                    with closing(_lib.Conn("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=1)) as client:
+                        assert client.must("PING") == b"PONG"
+                    break
+                except (OSError, EOFError):
+                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                        raise
+                    time.sleep(0.1)
+            with closing(_lib.Conn("127.0.0.1", port)) as client:
+                info = _lib.info(client, "server")
+                assert info["thread_mode"] == mode and int(info["shards"]) == 16, info
+                topology = _lib.topology(client)
+                roles = list(topology.roles.values())
+                assert len(roles) == 8, roles
+                if not fused:
+                    assert roles.count("io") == 6 and roles.count("ex") == 2, roles
+                run["info_server"] = info
+                run["roles"] = topology.roles
+                (directory / "geometry.txt").write_bytes(client.must("DEBUG", "LBSIGNALS"))
+                hooks = []
+                for name, value in [("ATOMIC-COMMIT-HOLD", "1"), ("ATOMIC-COMMIT-HOLD", "0"),
+                                    ("ATOMIC-COMMIT-DELAY", "0"), ("ATOMIC-FANOUT-DEFER", "0")]:
+                    assert client.must("DEBUG", name, value) == b"OK", (name, value)
+                    hooks.append(f"DEBUG {name} {value}: OK")
+                shard = client.must("DEBUG", "SHARD", "fixmerge:probe")
+                shards = client.must("DEBUG", "SHARDS", "fixmerge:probe")
+                assert shards == [[shard, topology.shard_owner[shard]]], shards
+                hooks.append("DEBUG SHARD/SHARDS/LBSIGNALS: OK")
+                (directory / "debug.txt").write_text("\n".join(hooks) + "\n")
+                if fused:
+                    assert info["read_local"] == "1"
+                    assert client.must("MSET", "fixmerge:a", "one", "fixmerge:b", "two") == b"OK"
+                    assert client.must("MGET", "fixmerge:a", "fixmerge:b") == [b"one", b"two"]
+                    run["smoke"] = "PASS: PING, MSET/MGET, DEBUG, 1s read-local armed"
+            if not fused:
+                for test, extra in [("atomic_torn", ["--release-build"]), ("atomic_ryow", [])]:
+                    args = ["taskset", "-c", "16-23", sys.executable,
+                            str(ROOT / "tests" / (test + ".py")), "127.0.0.1", str(port)] + extra
+                    entry = {"name": test, "command": args}
+                    run["batteries"].append(entry)
+                    started = time.monotonic()
+                    with (directory / (test + ".log")).open("w") as output:
+                        child = subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
+                        entry["pid"] = child.pid
+                        save()
+                        try:
+                            entry["exit"] = child.wait(timeout=900)
+                        finally:
+                            stop(child)
+                    entry["seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
+                    text = (directory / (test + ".log")).read_text()
+                    entry["ok_rows"] = sum(line.startswith("  ok   ") for line in text.splitlines())
+                    entry["fail_rows"] = [line for line in text.splitlines() if "FAIL" in line]
+                    entry["witnesses"] = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()
+                                          if "atomic-window" in line or "reclaims leases" in line]
+                    print(f"{directory.name} {test}: exit={entry['exit']}, "
+                          f"ok={entry['ok_rows']}, seconds={entry['seconds']}", flush=True)
+                    save()
+                    assert entry["exit"] == 0 and not entry["fail_rows"], entry
+            run["result"] = "PASS"
+        except BaseException as exc:
+            run["error"] = repr(exc)
+            run["result"] = "FAIL"
+            raise
+        finally:
+            try:
+                run["server_exit"] = stop(server)
+            finally:
+                log.flush()
+                reports = [json.loads(line[len("shutdown_report "):])
+                           for line in (directory / "server.log").read_text().splitlines()
+                           if line.startswith("shutdown_report ")]
+                run["shutdown"] = reports[-1] if reports else None
+                save()
+    assert run["server_exit"] == 0, run["server_exit"]
+    assert run["shutdown"] is not None, "missing shutdown report"
+    assert all(value == 0 for value in run["shutdown"]["stuck"].values()), run["shutdown"]["stuck"]
+    print(f"STOP {directory.name}: exit=0, all stuck fields zero", flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    for number in range(1, 6):
+        run_boot(number)
+    run_boot(1, fused=True)
+    print("PASS all five split battery pairs and fused smoke", flush=True)
diff --git a/tests/atomicwindow.py b/tests/atomicwindow.py
index b7155dcb4501de64ca5a76e23e124767183b29c5..9a3ae30879e5c950edadfbbcf1b62c63dd9184ce
--- a/tests/atomicwindow.py
+++ b/tests/atomicwindow.py
@@ -90,6 +90,7 @@
             lease_checked = not reconfigure
             lease_pool = None
             isolated_config = False
+            lease_reclaims = 0
 
             def run(index, client):
                 try:
@@ -226,6 +227,22 @@
                         if time.monotonic() >= config_deadline:
                             raise AssertionError("old lease accounting did not settle within "
                                                  "arm budget: %r" % table)
+                        if (not burst_done and table["inflight"] == 1 and
+                                table["credit_pool"] == 0):
+                            # The parked EXEC can keep its IO active after that IO's MSETs
+                            # retire. Their unused credits stay in its local lease, so another
